title: Competing ion effect in the crystal solution and thin films of 2D organic-spacer-incorporated 3D perovskites
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00803D, Paper
Mi-Hee Jung
We prepared quasi-2D perovskites using the co-spacers guanidium (GA) + ethylammonium (EA) and GA + imidazolium (IM) by forming crystals in solution and thin films for solar cells.
